data.name: Bisho
data.gender_notes: Bisho is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bisho is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishwa' which means 'all' or 'universal'. The name Bisho is a term of endearment for a child who is believed to bring joy and light to the lives of those around them. The name Bisho carries the meaning “Bringer of Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Bisho usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to be a bringer of joy, light, and blessings to the world.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bisho total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
